rule: Erase the noise colour (the colour of the scattered single dots). The largest remaining object is a board with holes; every other object is a piece drawn at scale k, where k is the gcd of the piece box sides. Output the board scaled by k, painting each hole with the colour of the piece whose shrunken shape is congruent to the hole under rotation or reflection. Each piece fills one hole, and congruent pieces share a colour.
scope: Constructive polyomino-hole assembly with integer-scaled D4-transformed pieces, removable dot/cluster noise, repeated shape classes and a scaled filled output board. Native scales two/three, optional four, on bounded varied rectangular canvases.
constraints: Three unchanged canonical pairs reconstructed exactly.

1240 unique independently decoded puzzles include 487 with equal-area competing shapes, 317 requiring reflection, 627 with repeated shape classes, and 262 with noise inside concave piece bounding boxes.
All 90 minimum-canvas trials succeed at scales two/three/four, with maximum measured generation time below 0.128 seconds.
Scale is sampled once per scene and retained across retries; 1000 default draws contain 674 scale-two and 326 scale-three scenes.
Broader explicit one-class scenes, four-cell noise blob with isolated-dot evidence, and scale-five monomino scene all agree with the saved transform.
Final critic parameter proposals: 31 successes and 7 expected rejections.
known_limitations: Native scale-four scenes have monomino/domino/straight-triomino holes only, so do not supply equal-area shape competition.
Random hole vocabulary is 1..7 cells in bounded boxes, with 8-separated holes and no enclosed board islands.
Explicit scenes support one shape class, larger noise components with an identifying isolated dot, and larger fitting scales; these are documented extensions.

authored_constraints: Background 0 is the strict majority colour of the input.
Board box area is strictly larger than every scaled piece box area.
The gcd of all logical piece dimensions is 1, so the piece box gcd equals k.
At least two non-congruent hole classes, and at least one hole with 2 or more cells.
Holes are 4-connected, single-colour, off the board rim and mutually 8-separated; the board cells stay 4-connected.
Board and piece boxes do not overlap or touch, diagonally included.
Noise cells are distinct. They never lie in or touch the board box, never touch piece cells, and include at least one 8-isolated single dot.
Congruent pieces share a colour, distinct classes get distinct colours, and piece colours differ from the board and noise colours.
Each hole's colour class matches the piece multiset of that colour exactly.
The output is (board_h*k) x (board_w*k), at most 30x30.
